name: Tabs
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Tabs(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

TabsContent.description: The panel for the TabsTrigger with the same `value:` - hidden unless its tab is selected.

TabsList.description: The row (or column) of TabsTriggers, with the sliding active indicator. `variant:` / `size:` override the root's; `activate_on_focus: true` switches panels as the arrow keys move focus; `loop_focus: false` stops at the ends.

TabsTrigger.description: One tab (`<button role="tab">`) for the TabsContent with the same `value:`. `disabled: true` skips it; `icon: true` makes a square, label-less tab (give it an aria_label:).

examples.name: Usage
Variants
examples.notes: `:pill` rides a filled track; `:line` slides an underline under the active tab.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-8") do
    %i[ pill line ].each do |variant|
      Tabs(default_value: "overview", variant:) { TabsList { PANELS.each { |value, (label, _)| TabsTrigger(value:) { label } } } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-6") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each do |size|
      Tabs(default_value: "overview", size:) { TabsList { PANELS.each { |value, (label, _)| TabsTrigger(value:) { label } } } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Vertical
examples.notes: Triggers stack beside their panels; ↑/↓ move between them.

examples.name: With icons & badges
Icon-only
examples.notes: `icon: true` makes square tabs - label each one.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.notes: Dispatch `ui--tabs:select` with { value } to switch from elsewhere; `ui--tabs:change` reports it.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.notes: A disabled tab is skipped by the arrow keys.

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The indicator and ←/→ follow the reading direction.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-8") do
    %i[ pill line ].each do |variant|
      Tabs(default_value: "overview", variant:) do
        TabsList do
          TabsTrigger(value: "overview") { "نظرة عامة" }
          TabsTrigger(value: "activity") { "النشاط" }
          TabsTrigger(value: "settings") { "الإعدادات" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
